text:
Asha: Quick sync 10m. Need final run-of-show, headline AB tests, and lead-routing plan. Keep replies short.
Liam: Idea: two headline pathsone technical ("Keep LLM features online: routing & graceful degradation") and one buyer-focused ("How to avoid LLM downtime: a playbook for platform teams").
Priya: We'll run both as AB on the landing page and email subject lines. I can prep 4 subject variants.
Sam: Ops: rehearsal windows? Need full dress 24h prior + 15m greenroom. Also need fallback clip and recording permission slide.
Noor: Demo notes: 18m live demo showing cache-hit path, small-model failover, and region fallback. 5m for quick recovery checklist. Need KV-enabled snapshot + small quant model.
Diego: Speaker rotation: Noor opens demo, Mei joins for a quick infra slide, Carlos (customer) for 3-min impact vignette, panel for Q. Keep transitions crisp.
Mei: I can do a 6-slide infra mini-deep-dive. Will include p95 charts and cost delta by path.
Asha: Lead routing: marketing captures gated runbook download -> SDR queue for mid-market. Dev-trial signups go to product-qualified leads team. Agree?
Liam: Agree. Add hidden field on LP to tag "dataplane" vs "platform" intent so SDRs can route accordingly.
Priya: Email nurture: 1) Thank-you + runbook 2) Short clip of demo 3) Benchmarks & invited eval. Schedule 3 emails over 10 days.
Sam: Rehearsal checklist: local network test, mic check, test keys, demo data reset, fallback video file, recording confirmation. I'll post as a doc.
Noor: For infra request: eng-runtime please spin a 3-hour test pool Mon 09:00-12:00 PT with KV=true and small-quant model. Command were using locally: `./provision_demo.sh --env=test --kv=true --small-model=ggml-q4_0.bin`
eng-runtime: noted. Ping me the exact snapshot tag and time window. Can provision in that window.
Liam: Landing page copy brief: 1-sentence hook, 3 bullets (what you'll learn), 1 CTA. AB headline variants attached in doc.
Diego: Mic-check ops: I'll book a 30-min slot the day before for speaker audio checks. Ops-bot: create rehearsal invites please.
ops-bot: Rehearsal invites created: "Webinar rehearsal 1 day-before" Tue Jun 11 09:30 PDT and "Greenroom" Wed Jun 12 09:45 PDT.
Asha: Next actions: Liam = finalize AB headlines + LP draft by Tue EOD; Priya = email cadence + subject lines; Noor = confirm demo infra by Wed; Sam = publish rehearsal checklist + book rehearsals; Diego = confirm customer vignette. Add blockers below. :thumbsup:
